notes.title: 🌟🚙 Car Quest Tips and Tricks with @SolarPellets 😎
notes.content:
What do you do if one of your favourite Nintendo Switch games isn't available on PC? If you're @SolarPellets you make friends with the developer - Ezone.com - and port it yourself!

Join @SolarPellets as he plays through some key locations in the game and runs through the main differences between the Switch and PC versions. He'll also have some speedrunning tips and stories about the porting process.

notes.title: 🌟🚙 Car Quest Speedrun World Record Attempt with @BaronBishop 🏆
notes.content:
Join @BaronBishop as he attempts to break the Car Quest speedrun world record.

@BaronBishop has been a key member of the Car Quest for Nintendo Switch speedrunning community, now he puts himself to the test in front of a live audience as he attempts to set the first world record for the PC version.
